positioning_rationale: Published work already establishes parameterization, cocycle iteration, continuous orthogonalization, covariant Lyapunov vectors, real and periodic Schur reordering, CR3BP quasi-periodic torus computation, and invariant-manifold construction. The defensible contribution is therefore an auditable numerical framework and systematic comparison with independent-backend validation and visible failure modes, not a new theorem or first algorithm.
truth_boundaries: The frozen McCarthy reproduction level is unchanged.
The Chapter 4 projection holdout remains 0/4 with paper_projection=fail and paper_3d=false.
The Route H corrected-rho physical cases remain two-dimensional real conjugate subspaces and are not promoted to one-dimensional bundles.
The legacy seed-rho Route H row remains a positive control and is not substituted for the physical operator.
Verified literature coverage and completed independent validation do not by themselves establish submission readiness.
